hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the causeway back is south

wards.name: the tide gate
wards.denied: The last stretch of causeway is under a hand's depth of water and a portcullis is down in it. Break it, or hold the warden's key, and not otherwise.
wards.opened: The portcullis goes over sideways and the water takes it.

spots.line: The arch stands in the lake with nothing holding it up that you can see.
The water inside the ring does not move with the rest of the lake.
Mooring rings set into the stone, worn bright. Something still ties up here.
The causeway is a foot under at high water. It is not high water yet.

chests.line: A strongbox lashed to the arch itself, above the waterline by a hand.
A net bag snagged on the causeway edge, heavy with what it caught.

people.name: Ferrick of the Causeway
chatter: Tide's out. That's the only reason you're standing where you are.
Three hours. Then the road you came on is a lake again.
I ferry people off it who left it too late. I charge them.
Whatever's under the arch doesn't mind the water. Bear that in mind.

people.name: Sull, mending a boat
chatter: She'll float. She won't float far.
You can't row round it. People try. The water goes wrong out there.
If you hear the rings knocking, get off the causeway.
